messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: last week's outage. I'm collecting the RCA link and owners for the action items. Post confirmations here so we can close the loop.

sam: RCA is up at https://redwood-infra.internal/rcas/2024-04-24-nvme-autoscaler.pdf. Summary: NVMe controller firmware bug + aggressive autoscaler churn caused KV cache thrash -> elevated tail latency and transient 5xxs.

anika: Thanks. Did we already pin firmware everywhere or just in canaries?

ryan: Pinned in control-plane clusters yesterday at 16:00 UTC. Canary pool in prod-us-west has received it; no regressions in the last 8 hours. Still running extended soak.

leah: Support reported ~6% spike in 5xxs during the outage window. We sent an initial notice to affected customers; customer success will follow up with personalized notes.

maria: Action items from the all-hands: 1) @sam - create 1-page RCA summary and checklist and ensure it's linked in incidents (owner: sam). 2) @ryan - run controlled canary scale test and post metrics + graphs (owner: ryan). 3) @anika - file a roadmap ticket to add autoscaler rollback + verification steps (owner: anika). 4) @leah - finalize customer comms template and coordinate with AMs (owner: leah). Please confirm ownership and ETA.

sam: Confirmed. I'll add the summary and checklist by EOD and tag incidents. Also will prepare a 2-line blurb for the next all-hands slide.

anika: I'll open PD-4823 for the rollback/verification work and add acceptance criteria. ETA: tomorrow morning.

ryan: Running the canary scale test this afternoon. I'll post results in #eng-sre and open a PR for an autoscaler throttling test.

devops-bot: Incident 2024-04-24 RCA uploaded: https://redwood-infra.internal/rcas/2024-04-24-nvme-autoscaler.pdf

violet: Quick question: do we have instrumentation to detect KV cache thrash proactively? Could be useful to add an alert.

ryan: We have some counters but not a dedicated alert. Adding monitoring + an alert for sustained cache miss amplification makes sense; will add to the canary test checklist.

leah: I'll sync with AMs after the support draft is final and share the customer-facing timeline.

maria: Thanks all. We'll review progress in Thursday's SRE sync. If anyone hits blockers, DM me or post in #eng-oncall. Closing the live all-hands follow-up thread.
